subject: MPA: staged ingest, sandbox rotation & retirement timeline
messages:
From: Emma Thomson <emma@brightshop.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: staged ingest plan for eval dataset and sandbox rotation

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. Per our conversation, we're ready to proceed with a staged evaluation exchange so your engineers can run the BrightShop testcases on Redwood.

Attached is a first-pass manifest (BrightShop_eval_manifest.csv) and a short MAP doc that sketches the ingest windows. Key asks from our side:
- Ephemeral sandbox access for 2 dev teams (dataops + search) for 4 weeks.
- One-way, limited-use license for the prompt pack and testcase set; no re-sharing outside Redwood evaluators.
- Post-eval destruction confirmation within 7 days of end-date (our legal team requires audit evidence).

Proposed timetable (we can adjust):
1) Week 0 (Mar 15 release): transfer CSV manifest + encrypted artifact bundle to your S3 staging (we'll provide credentials).
2) Week 1: Redwood ingests into ephemeral sandboxes; smoke tests run by your infra.
3) Weeks 2–4: evaluation runs, with weekly syncs.
4) Week 5: closure and destruction; we expect a signed destruction attestation and a short acceptance note.

Open items we need from you to finalize the MAP:
- Exact S3 ingest path + contact for creds rotation
- Point of contact for audit evidence (log format we accept attached in MAP_staged_ingest_v1.pdf)
- Confirmation of sandbox retention policy and auto-destroy window

Let me know if the timeline is tight — we can compress to a 3-week sprint if helpful.

Thanks,
Emma Thomson
Head of Data Partnerships
BrightShop
emma@brightshop.ai

Attachments: BrightShop_eval_manifest.csv (CSV), MAP_staged_ingest_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Thomson <emma@brightshop.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: staged ingest plan for eval dataset and sandbox rotation

Emma — thanks for the clear plan and the artifacts. This looks straightforward; a few quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates.

On the high level we can do the staged ingest + ephemeral sandboxes as proposed. Specifics:
- Ingest path: we prefer you upload to the Redwood transfer bucket (we'll share a presigned PUT). Flow: you upload -> our transfer job validates manifest -> artifact synced to ephemeral sandboxes.
- Retention: sandboxes are ephemeral and will auto-delete data 7 days after the end of the evaluation window unless you request a 30-day archival hold.
- Audit evidence: we can generate a destruction attestation and a short audit log (CSV with event timestamps). Ben will confirm log schema.

Two asks before we confirm Mar 15 start:
1) Can BrightShop accept the presigned PUT flow instead of providing long-lived creds? (better for rotation)
2) We need a short addendum that captures the limited-use license and no-redistribution clause — Marissa will draft one and route to your legal.

If those are OK we'll send the presigned link and target the ingest on Tue Mar 16 09:00 PT.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships (Evaluation Programs)
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Emma / Kim — quick follow-up from the ops side. We reviewed the manifest. Two technical notes and one legal/usage confirmation.

Technical notes:
- Checksum and provenance: please include SHA256 checksums for each archive in the manifest (we flagged a missing checksum for "prompt_pack_v1.tar.gz"). We won't ingest without checksums.
- File size: one of the sample bundles is ~18GB. Our presigned PUT has a 48-hour expiry; if upload will take longer we'll provide a multipart upload policy.

Legal / usage confirmation: we've asked Marissa to prepare an addendum that includes the limited-use clause you requested. Practically:
- Redwood evaluators only; no downstream sharing outside Redwood engineers working on this deal.
- Logs and destruction attestations will be produced as a CSV and a signed PDF attestation.

I've attached a draft of the addendum (inline in this thread) and a short checklist we use for MAP acceptance. Please review.

Ben Carter
Sales Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Kim / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the following so we can finalize the MAP and sign off: 
- BrightShop will use presigned PUT uploads; we will include SHA256 checksums in the manifest.
- We accept the limited-use addendum; legal review is happy with the language Marissa circulated.
- Target ingest: Tue Mar 16 09:00 PT (we will upload Monday night PST to avoid heavy transfer windows).
- Post-eval destruction: BrightShop requests evidence within 7 days; Redwood will provide the CSV audit log + signed PDF attestation.

I attached a signed acceptance line (simple yes) and a link to our procurement ticket for your reference. If you can send the presigned PUT by EOD Mon Mar 15 we'll begin the upload.

Thanks again — excited to get this running.
